# Incident Response

Incidents are graded severity 1 to 4. A severity-1 incident — total loss of
service or suspected data compromise — must be acknowledged by the on-call
engineer within 15 minutes and receives a status update at least every 30
minutes until resolved.

Severity 2 covers degraded service with a workaround and is acknowledged
within 1 hour. Severities 3 and 4 are handled in business hours.

If an investigation confirms a personal data breach, affected customers are
notified within 72 hours of confirmation, together with the supervisory
authority where the law requires it. Every severity-1 incident gets a
written post-mortem within 5 working days.
